governs: Part C of CHATGPT-CONSTITUTION-20260822-v001.md, where it differs from the prose. The executable form is tools/triagectl.py.

population.consequence: Every count here is an input, not a finding. A census returning different numbers changes the migration arithmetic and not the design.

assessment_of_prior_design.subject: disposition by default, a stratified audit sample, and a pre-declared error threshold so the sweep self-accepts and the founder sets one number

corrections.was: the founder sees a fixed-size stratified sample and confirms or rejects the sweep as a whole
corrections.defect: reading a sample and judging classifications is evidence comparison, which the standing non-negotiable puts off-limits alongside retrieval, monitoring, merging and coordination. Reducing it from 182 items to 30 reduces the violation; it does not remove it.
corrections.now: the audit lane reads the sample. The founder sets the number and receives the verdict. His total involvement in the whole programme is one number, once, in advance.
corrections.objection_and_answer: Who audits the auditor? Not trust: the audit is an acceptance act and the estate's existing acceptance machinery applies - a different run, criteria committed before the sweep, a different exact model configuration, committed artifacts only, and a hermetic no-network container available for replay. That arrangement has already refused this controller's own evidence.

corrections.was: the sweep grades its own sample
corrections.now: triagectl judge refuses when auditor_lane equals sweeper_lane, and refuses when either is undeclared
corrections.evidence: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED in receipts/.../raw/triagectl-reproduction.txt: the same observation returns ACCEPT with distinct lanes and INADMISSIBLE with AUDITOR_IS_SWEEPER when they match

corrections.defect: it conflates two errors with very different costs. Wrongly archiving thirty chit-chat threads costs nothing; wrongly archiving one thread holding a founder decision costs the estate its memory.
corrections.now: two rates measured, one gated. The founder sets the tolerable rate of consequential misclassification; the nuisance rate is reported, never gated. Still exactly one number from him.
corrections.second_order_fix: sample allocation by cost of error rather than in proportion to volume, because a proportional sample under-samples the expensive stratum exactly when it is largest

corrections.was: reject the whole sweep and re-run it with corrected rules, never patch item by item
corrections.defect: right rule, no termination guarantee. Three failed sweeps cost more than the review they replaced and nothing notices.
corrections.now: the retry budget is declared in the same act as the threshold. When exhausted the sweep does not run again: unresolved items are dispositioned FREEZE_AS_EVIDENCE, which is reversible and loses no information, and the repeated failure becomes a finding about the claim predicates rather than a backlog.

corrections.was: a stratified sample as the instrument, at any population size
corrections.defect: only visible on running the arithmetic. By the rule of three a 1% tolerance demands 300 items; the readable population in the worked stratum set is 167. The sample is the population, so sampling buys nothing and costs the statistical caveats.
corrections.now: triagectl plan emits an instrument_check. For the first sweep, audit everything readable and the measured rate is exact rather than bounded. The sampling machinery stays for recurring sweeps and for a larger-than-reported population.
corrections.why_the_prior_design_could_not_see_it: it inherited the instinct that review effort is scarce. Review effort is scarce when a person reviews. An agent auditing 167 items is a cheap batch job.
corrections.evidence: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED: tolerance 0.01 returns FULL_AUDIT_RECOMMENDED at target 300 against 167 readable; tolerance 0.05 returns SAMPLE_IS_APPROPRIATE at 60

SALVAGE.applies_to: claimed, decision-bearing, content routed to its owning function

FREEZE_AS_EVIDENCE.also: the terminal fallback when the retry budget is exhausted

ARCHIVE_UNCLAIMED.why_heaviest: the only disposition where an item leaves the visible set

CANNOT_ASSESS.applies_to: surfaces that would not render or were absent from the export
CANNOT_ASSESS.rule: never sampled, because it was not read; always in the coverage denominator, so a blind spot lowers a number rather than disappearing

outcomes_needing_attention_rather_than_d.CONTESTED: two functions claim it and neither owns the class
outcomes_needing_attention_rather_than_d.DECISION_BEARING_BUT_UNOWNED: the most valuable output of the sweep - the back catalogue telling the register which function it is missing. Routed as a warrant seed.

deletion.rule: Nothing is deleted. Deletion is a separate, later, explicitly authorised act.
deletion.basis: the repository's own rule that superseded material remains evidence

exit_condition.prior: retire when the unswept backlog is zero and new chats arrive pre-bound

evidence_that_it_is_unreachable.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
evidence_that_it_is_unreachable.quotation: Start a chat from ChatGPT Home when the chat doesn't need shared project files, instructions, or sources.
evidence_that_it_is_unreachable.reading: Chats started outside any project are a supported first-class flow, not a lapse in discipline. A chat-opening contract binds chats spawned by bound functions, so unbound chats keep arriving by construction and the backlog never reaches zero.

exit_condition.an_earlier_fix_and_why_it_is_not_enough: A later lane found the same defect and re-specified salvage as a permanent recurring sweep with a rate target. The diagnosis is right; the fix accepts a permanent cost rather than removing it, and pays the same rate whether or not the sweep is finding anything.

replacement.target: novel decision-bearing yield is zero across N consecutive sweeps
replacement.N: declared by the founder alongside the triage numbers, or defaulted to 3
replacement.on_met: salvage downgrades from EXHAUSTIVE to SPOT_CHECK. It does not vanish; it stops being exhaustive.
replacement.why_reachable: It does not require unbound chats to stop existing. It requires them to stop carrying anything the ledger does not already hold, which is what a working capture route produces: a decision reaches git when it is made, so a later unbound chat holds at most a duplicate.
replacement.dual_use: a persistently non-zero yield is the pre-registered falsifier for the capture function. Intent is still forming outside capture and the sweep is the only thing catching it. Two functions check each other and neither can report success while the other fails.
replacement.cost_shape: indexed to what the sweep finds rather than a fixed rate paid regardless

content_route.primary: owner data export, one owner action, everything after it delegable to a container

evidence.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
evidence.finding: help.openai.com returns HTTP 403 to an unauthenticated fetch, so the export article could not be read. A prior lane recorded the same result.

unknowns_all_HYPOTHESIS: whether the export includes project-scoped chats
where the control is in settings
content_route.why_timestamps_matter_beyond_the_sweep: Without per-message timestamps a recovered utterance is UNTRUSTED under the Part B rule, which removes the recency resolution path and pushes more conflicts to fail closed. That is the correct behaviour and it is a real cost.
fallbacks_in_order: If the export omits project chats, sweep what it contains and report the missing stratum inside the denominator as CANNOT_ASSESS. Never report coverage of what was readable as coverage of what exists.
If the export route cannot be located, the discovery function establishes it at zero founder cost, because finding out what the account offers is its job.
If neither works, the back catalogue stays unswept and is recorded as an owned blind spot with a risk-conversion date - worse than a sweep, far better than an assumed-clean estate.

projects.procedure: the existing assignment procedure - reuse as is, repurpose, split, freeze as evidence, or create new - driven by the census rather than by a target count
projects.no_count_imposed: Project count follows separation requirements. A census returning a number other than eleven changes the migration, not the design.

one_addition.rule: Disposition containers before sweeping their chats.
one_addition.why: A chat's correct disposition depends on whether its container survives. Sweeping first produces correctly-classified chats inside frozen projects, which is a second migration nobody planned.

founder_involvement_total.what: the consequential-misclassification tolerance and the retry budget, set together, in advance
